name: Split Formation - Z Right - Y Slant Pass Right
call: Split Formation Z Right Y Slant Pass Right

Y.rule: Take one step up, then slant out flat toward the right sideline, almost along the line of scrimmage. Look for the ball right away.

QB.rule: Take the snap, take one step and throw to the right tight end as he slants out. If he is covered, tuck it and run.

coaching_points: Everybody but the tight end and the Z pass blocks: step back, hands up, stay between your man and the quarterback.
The slant stays flat — one step up and out, almost on the line of scrimmage. Any deeper and he runs into the linebackers.
The quarterback throws it as soon as the tight end clears the end. If he is covered, tuck it and run — no second look.
